title: Read a route value
summary: A bracketed page file captures part of an address.

Explain the example for read a route value

blocks.text: A bracketed page file captures part of an address. useRoute gives the page access to that route value.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.
Read the code step by step

items: `useRoute` reads the active route, including captured values under `params`.

blocks.text: The route /books/moon-trip displays Book: moon-trip. Static generation must be told which such routes to build.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A dynamic route pattern does not generate every possible static page by itself.
